summary: Create a public OAuth connection in the Notion Developer portal, choose its installation scope once (Any workspace or Selected workspaces only), and implement the OAuth authorization and token-exchange flow on your server. Listing on the Notion Marketplace is optional and requires Any workspace scope plus review by the Notion team, typically within 5-10 business days. Personal access tokens are for your own scripts only and do not provide an OAuth install flow for other users.

scenarios.label: Any workspace, not listed on Marketplace

steps.title: Create a public connection in the Developer portal
steps.detail: Navigate to the Notion Developer portal, create a new public connection, and fill out the form including redirect URI(s) under OAuth configuration and the installation scope (Any workspace or Selected workspaces only). Remember the scope cannot be changed after creation.

steps.title: Implement server-side OAuth authorization and token exchange
steps.detail: Build the authorization URL redirect to https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize, handle the callback, and exchange the authorization code for an access token on a server you control using the client ID and client secret. Never expose the client secret in browser source.
steps.agent_prompt: Write server-side code (Node/Python/etc.) that redirects the user to Notion's OAuth authorization URL, receives the authorization code, POSTs to the token endpoint with client credentials, stores the access token securely, and sets the Notion-Version header.

steps.title: Optionally submit a Marketplace listing
steps.detail: If you want the app discoverable by all Notion users, ensure the connection scope is Any workspace, go to Listings > Connections, start a new connection listing, fill in details, save as draft, and submit for review by the Notion team.

blockers.symptom: You want to list on the Marketplace but the connection was created with Selected workspaces only scope.
blockers.fix: Create a new public connection with Any workspace scope, because installation scope cannot be changed after creation.

blockers.symptom: Marketplace listing is not approved or is rejected.
blockers.fix: Review the Notion team's feedback email, make changes, and resubmit the listing.

blockers.symptom: You need an OAuth install flow for other users but only have a personal access token.
blockers.fix: Create a public connection instead; PATs do not provide an OAuth install flow for other users.

composio.notes: Check the toolkit page for managed auth. To bring your own app, register the redirect URI shown when you create a custom auth config.
